title: ToolInvocationRequested
description: Emitted by orchestrator.ts to dispatch a single tool call. Topic: tool-invocation-requests.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch milliseconds at the time the event was produced.

eventType.description: Discriminator field identifying the event type.

toolName.description: Name of the tool to invoke (e.g. "weather", "math", "exchange", "getProductInformation").

input.description: Tool-specific input parameters as a free-form key-value map.
